interpretation: Independent saved-image matching adds an origin constraint but does not establish a fixed100ms correction.
EX01 representative confirmed capture spans61.8073ms and near-identical matched video frames span33.333ms, leaving95.14ms conditional origin range.
EX02 confirmed capture spans30.465ms and matching frames span16.667ms, leaving47.132ms conditional range.
Ranges omit unknown screen/game/OBS path offset; video quantization alone makes near-zero differences compatible. They are not measured latency or statistical confidence bounds.
The earlier approximately33ms threshold-to-fitted-origin comparison did not independently certify absolute physical origin.
Existing recordings do not show F8 or first-match markers in a shared capture path. Repeated successful trials alone will not recover missing clock linkage.
nextMeasurement: If continuing experimentally, retain pre-match/first-match/confirmed frames and their capture intervals, and capture game plus a timestamped detection/input marker through one shared image path. This is not yet implemented; use normal baseline timings rather than another boundary search.
